boundary_statement: A chain establishes that each named link's material exists and says what it says. It does not establish a claim about a compound, a target or a therapy. Its endpoints are only the topics it names.

enforced_rules.link_resolution: A link is resolved only when its self-record evidence list names at least one declared entry with access opened and a local repository file. An empty list or only non-opened entries leaves it unresolved. A missing opened file is refused.
enforced_rules.unresolved_breaks_chain: A chain with any unresolved link cannot be reported as a supported claim.
enforced_rules.no_biological_conclusion: A chain cannot establish a conclusion about a compound, target or therapy.
